text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Adverse reactions reported with overdosage of intravenous ganciclovir included irreversible pancytopenia, acute renal failure requiring hemodialysis, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, hepatitis, and seizures. Since ganciclovir is dialyzable, dialysis may be useful in reducing serum concentrations. Adequate hydration should be maintained. The use of hematopoietic growth factors should be considered in patients with cytopenias [see Dosage and Administration ( 2.5 ), Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] .
